snippet_primary: "I find most Etsy sellers to be very honest and helpful. I can find very unusual and high-quality items not available elsewhere. The site is sometimes challenging to navigate, but worth the effort. Sure, there are some dishonest sellers, but I find Etsy sellers far more honest than those on eBay. Also when a recent purchase did not arrive both Etsy and the seller got a refund to my credit card in 48 hours, 30 minutes. That is why I prefer Etsy."
subject_exact: ConsumerAffairs reviewer (2025) praises Etsy for unique/high-quality items unavailable elsewhere, seller honesty compared to eBay, and fast refund (48h30m) for undelivered purchase; notes site navigation is sometimes challenging
